tools.name: email_reminder_subscribe
tools.description: Signs the signed-in user up for a Dipperfield email reminder, sent to the account’s email. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe. Free for every account. account_status says which reminders the user is already on.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account_status · Public sink: account_status, email_reminder_subscribe, email_reminder_unsubscribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account_status · Public sink: account_status, email_reminder_subscribe, email_reminder_unsubscribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
